body:
## Problem

`packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js`, `abe-cunningham` entry (Deftones "White Pony" 2000 era), `setup.sticks` block (lines 5720-5734):
```
sticks: {
  item: 'Vic Firth American Classic 5A',
  model: 'Lighter hickory taper',
  specs: 'Hickory, 5A diameter',
  originalPrice: 8,
  year: 2000,
  source: 'Standard retail price 2000',
  notes: "Switched to a lighter 5A for the control and nuance White Pony's quieter, more dynamic passages required.",
  ...
},
```
This is a distinct field from #7055 (already fixed this entry's drums field — an invented ddrum→Pearl switch, corrected to career-long Tama, confirmed live: current `setup.drums` already says `'Tama Starclassic'`). The sticks field was never addressed and still fabricates a Vic Firth brand/switch that doesn't exist in the verified record.

## Verified (internal source of truth)

`packages/frontend/data/endorsementNews.js`, `abe-cunningham` timeline:
```
{ year: 1997, changeType: SIGNED, category: STICKS, from: null, to: 'Pro-Mark',
  notes: 'Settled on Pro-Mark sticks starting with "Around the Fur" (1997), later formalized into his signature TX916W model' },
```
`currentEndorsements.sticks: { brand: 'Pro-Mark', since: '1997' }` — a `from: null` first-ever signing, no subsequent STICKS timeline entry exists at all (unlike cymbals, which does have documented 2010 and 2022 switches). Pro-Mark has been his only documented stick brand for his entire career — Vic Firth never appears anywhere in the record.

## Fix

In `packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js`, `abe-cunningham` `setup.sticks` block: change `item` from `'Vic Firth American Classic 5A'` to `'Pro-Mark'` (verified brand; a specific Pro-Mark model for the 2000 era is not independently sourced, so keep the model generic unless one can be externally verified), remove the fabricated "switched to a lighter 5A" narrative since no stick-brand switch is documented in his career. Cymbals field (Zildjian A/K Custom for this era, correctly reflecting the 1997-2010 Zildjian window before the verified 2010 Sabian/2022 Zildjian-return switches) and heads field (Remo, matching verified since-1997 record) are both already correct and should not be touched.

## Verify
- [ ] `grep -n "Vic Firth American Classic 5A" packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js` within the abe-cunningham 2000 setup block returns zero hits
- [ ] `setup.sticks` cites Pro-Mark, matching `endorsementNews.js`
- [ ] Drums (already fixed by #7055), cymbals, and heads fields left untouched

## Done
`gearPriceHistory.js`'s `abe-cunningham` `setup.sticks` block matches `endorsementNews.js`'s verified Pro-Mark-since-1997 record with no fabricated brand switch; zero new pages/URLs.
title: SEO: Abe Cunningham gearPriceHistory.js 2000 setup.sticks claims Vic Firth — verified Pro-Mark since 1997, no documented switch
